page.layout: One page of text: a tree diagram (synopsis) with braces and brackets fills the page. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. Dangling bracket lines run from one box to the next, and small labels sit beside the braces.

main_text.l: Simplici, per solam Nutritionem: sive alimentum
Attrahedo etiam. Sic Fungus & Musci. Qua attractione
Perfectiore, quae non nutrit solu, sed generat etia. Cui Virtuti generativa adest Vis seminis
Ac Plantarum ita viventium considerantur tum,

page.notes: Diagram read from the drawing; levels follow the braces. Doubtful readings: "Idq;" (possibly "id est" abbreviated) and "Baq;" (could be "Eaq;"), both marked [?]. "Mi" at the foot is a truncated line, left as printed. Faint show-through of the reverse page and the bleed of the neighbouring page at the left edge are not transcribed. The label "Ac Plantarum ita viventium considerantur tum," is set beside a brace and is given its own line. The printed words "Vis seminis" are written out from the scan and the broken "Fru-/menta" is joined.
